sn3.13:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena rājā Pasenadi-kosalo doṇapākaṃ sudaṃ bhuñjati || || 2.
sn3.13:1.3: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo bhuttāvī mahassāsī yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3.
sn3.13:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā taṃ rājānaṃ Pasenadi-kosalaṃ bhuttāviṃ mahassāsiṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi ||
sn3.13:4.1: Tena kho pana samayena Sudassano mānavo rañño Pasenadi-kosalassa piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti || || 5.
sn3.13:4.2: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Sudassanaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi || ||
sn3.13:4.3: Ehi tvam tāta Sudassana Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham pariyāpuṇitvā mama bhattābhibāre bhāsa ||
sn3.13:4.4: ahaṃ ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ kahāpaṇasatam niccabhikkhaṃ pavaṭṭayissāmīti || || 6.
sn3.13:4.5: Evam devāti kho Sudassano māṇavo Pasenadi-kosalassa paṭisunitvā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham pariyāpuṇitvā rañño Pasenadi-kosalassa bhattābhihāre sudaṃ bhāsati || ||
sn3.13:6.1: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo anupubbena nāḷikodanaparamatāya saṇṭhāsi || || 8.
sn3.13:6.2: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo aparena samayena sallikhita-gatto pāṇinā gattāni anumajjanto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānam udānesi || ||
sn3.13:6.3: Ubhayena vata maṃ so Bhagavā atthena anukampi ||
sn3.13:6.4: diṭṭhadhammikena c-eva samparāyikena cā ti || || Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati. 1.
